name: cum-trend-populated
note: cum_trend crosses the same trust boundary as trends via the shared normalize function: a populated sparkline survives verbatim, and a row carrying an OSC-52 clipboard-write control sequence + BEL comes back with its control characters replaced. Also covers the fixed axis riding alongside a populated cum_trend, normalizing to the same 8-tick list Python's CUM_TREND_AXIS produces.
